author: EpicNinja
body:
So yeah, I'm apparently banned from the server (avic.us).
I just recently had a friend that wanted me to join the server, and I'm banned. I don't remember getting on this server ever. One side note, I did end up getting scammed into accidentally giving my account info (username and password). I was younger, and well oblivious to scams, at the time.

  • Your Minecraft username(most recent name if changed): EpicNinja
  • The reason you were temp-banned/banned: Scammer probably used a hack client to their advantage and my disadvantage.
  • Why you should be unbanned from the server: I was banned for something that was my fault (I fell for a scam).
Something you need to know, I did in fact change my password to prevent being scammed again.
Also, I was banned on a few other popular servers such as, Hypixel, Hive, Mineplex from the Scammer. The thing is, I, on the other servers, was banned for hacks of different kinds.

Ban info (Who Banned Me/ When I was banned): http://imgur.com/gtAF8Xk

replies.body:
Hello,

Due to the long wait since you've been banned, I will appeal this infraction. Make sure to never give your email and password to anyone.

Regards,
Pelpelajax,
Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
